title: Multilinear even coefficients
statement: For a natural number $n$, let $a$ assign a real coefficient to each finite set of indices from $	ext{Fin}(n+1)$. The even coefficient function on finite sets of indices from $	ext{Fin}(n)$ assigns to each set $S$ the coefficient indexed by the set obtained by shifting every index in $S$ up by one.
hypotheses_covered: Coefficient function on finite subsets of $	ext{Fin}(n+1)$
